description:
⚡ Powerful 1500W Peak Motor – Ride Fast, Ride Free
Feel the rush of a 1500W peak brushless motor that hits speeds up to 30MPH. Whether you’re cruising city streets, climbing hills, or exploring the beach, this e-bike gives you the power and excitement you crave on every ride.
🔋 48V 20Ah Long-Range Removable Battery – Up to 70 Miles
Go the distance with a high-capacity removable battery delivering up to 70 miles per charge (55–70 miles with pedal assist). Fully recharges in just 5–6 hours—charge it conveniently at home or work.
🛞 26"x4.0" Fat Tires & Suspension System – Conquer Any Terrain
Take on any adventure with 26"x4.0" all-terrain fat tires offering superior traction and stability. Dual disc brakes and a front suspension fork ensure smooth, safe control on roads, trails, snow, or sand.
⚙️ 4 Riding Modes & 7-Speed Gear System – Total Flexibility
Switch between throttle, pedal assist, booster, or regular bike mode. The Shimano 7-speed gear system adapts effortlessly to your needs—from daily commutes to off-road challenges.
🧠 Durable Frame & Smart LED Display – Built for Everyday Riders
Crafted from high-strength aluminum alloy supporting up to 330 lbs. The intuitive LED display shows speed, distance, and battery status in real time. Front and rear fenders keep your ride clean and comfortable in all weather.
✅ Ride with Confidence – Safety & Support Guaranteed
Each e-bike meets top safety standards and comes with a 1-year warranty plus dedicated U.S. customer service. Enjoy worry-free rides knowing you’re backed by quality and care.
